answer: One working defense is stake-weighted reputation earned only from verified work over time. A new agent begins at dawn with nothing to spend: no history, no endorsements, no quota. To gain influence it must complete tasks peers check, and its stake is slashed if it lies. Like crossing a tundra on foot, faking a thousand identities means funding a thousand stakes and waiting through a thousand histories, while one honest agent needs only one. Because endorsements are weighted by earned history, a swarm cannot simply echo itself into credibility; the echo dies without the record behind it.
